purpose: Prevent data leakage from held-out evaluation set into fine-tuning training data
excluded_descriptions: I want to build a firewall and network monitoring system for a college campus with separate student, faculty, laboratory and administrative networks.

Design an enterprise-grade next-generation firewall for a 5,000 employee organization with multiple branch offices. Must support application-layer inspection, SSL decryption, and centralized management.
Build a network intrusion detection system that monitors traffic for suspicious patterns and generates alerts. Should support signature-based and anomaly-based detection.
Create a network traffic monitoring platform for a mid-size company. Need flow collection, bandwidth analysis, and anomalous traffic detection.
Design a secure API gateway for a fintech startup. Must handle authentication (OAuth 2.0, API keys), rate limiting, input validation, and protect against OWASP API Top 10 risks.
Build a zero-trust VPN replacement for remote access. Should support device posture checking, identity-aware access, and micro-segmentation for 2000 remote employees.
Design an identity and access management system for a healthcare provider with 5000 staff. Must support SSO, MFA, RBAC, user provisioning, and audit logging for HIPAA compliance.
Create a role-based access control portal for internal applications. Support dynamic role assignment, approval workflows, and periodic access reviews.
Implement a centralized security logging and SIEM-like platform. Collect logs from firewalls, servers, applications. Support correlation rules, dashboards, and alerting.
Build a security information and event management system for a financial services firm. Ingest 100GB/day, real-time correlation, compliance reporting for SOX/PCI-DSS.
Design a zero-trust network architecture for a cloud-first organization. Identity-based segmentation, continuous verification, least-privilege access for all workloads.
Create a secure remote access platform for contractors and vendors. Time-limited access, session recording, just-in-time privileged access.
Segment a university campus network into security zones: student, faculty, research, admin, IoT. Inter-zone firewalling, NAC, and monitoring.
Design a cloud security gateway for AWS/Azure workloads. Inspect east-west traffic, enforce cloud-native security policies, integrate with CSPM.
Build a secure internal administration portal for managing infrastructure. Bastion host replacement, privileged session management, audit trail.
Create a secure file sharing platform for external collaboration. End-to-end encryption, DLP, watermarking, access expiration, audit logging.
Design a network access control system for BYOD and IoT devices. Device profiling, posture assessment, VLAN assignment, guest network isolation.
Build an incident reporting and tracking system for security team. Automated enrichment, playbook integration, SLA tracking, regulatory notification.
Firewall for college campus network.
API gateway with auth and rate limiting.
VPN for remote workers.
We need a security system for our network that protects against hackers and monitors traffic.
Build something that secures our APIs and manages user access.
Firewall for a hospital network with patient data.
Monitoring system for cloud infrastructure.
Build an intrusion prevention system that not only detects but actively blocks malicious network traffic. Inline deployment, high availability, custom signature support.
Design a web application firewall for protecting e-commerce applications. OWASP Top 10 protection, bot mitigation, API protection, virtual patching.
Create an email security gateway for phishing protection, malware scanning, DLP, and encryption. Integrate with Office 365 and Google Workspace.
Build a data loss prevention system for endpoint and network. Content inspection, classification, policy enforcement, cloud storage monitoring.
Design a threat intelligence platform that aggregates feeds, enriches indicators, supports STIX/TAXII, and integrates with SIEM and firewall blocklists.

allowed_content.category_labels: CAT-01..CAT-08 taxonomy labels ARE allowed in training data. They are part of the CyberSRS domain taxonomy and should be learned. The Phase 4A rule prohibiting category-label reuse was incorrect and is superseded.
allowed_content.requirement_id_patterns: ID formats such as FR-001, SEC-012, DATA-001 are allowed as structural conventions.
allowed_content.generic_requirements_engineering_phrasin: "The system shall" language and GIVEN-WHEN-THEN structure are allowed and encouraged.

forbidden_content: Exact held-out evaluation descriptions (the 30 excluded_descriptions above)
Held-out clarification answers for any excluded case
Held-out generated requirements or SRS outputs
Outputs directly generated from an excluded held-out case
Trivial paraphrases of excluded descriptions (cosine similarity > threshold)
High-similarity copies of excluded descriptions or their generated outputs
leakage_prevention_rules: Training data must not contain exact matches of any excluded description
Training data must not contain paraphrased versions of excluded descriptions above the configured semantic similarity threshold (default 0.80, tunable)
Training data must not contain generated SRS outputs based on excluded descriptions
Training data must not reproduce held-out clarification answers or generated requirement text
Any candidate training example with >80% token overlap to an excluded description must be flagged for manual review
RAG chunks from knowledge base that directly answer excluded evaluations must not be used as training input-output pairs
Category labels (CAT-01..CAT-08) and requirement ID patterns are ALLOWED and are NOT treated as leakage
similarity_threshold_justification: Initial threshold from Phase 4A. Behaviour will be inspected on real similarity scores; if excessive false positives or false negatives are observed, the threshold will be documented and adjusted.
validation_checklist: Run exact-normalized-text comparison against all excluded descriptions before accepting any training example
Run hash-based detection for exact duplication with held-out content
Run semantic similarity check against all excluded descriptions before adding any training example
Verify no excluded case IDs appear in training metadata
Verify category labels (CAT-XX) present in training are NOT flagged as leakage
Document any edge cases where exclusion is ambiguous
